title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in bPlugins Flash &…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in bPlugins Flash & HTML5 Video html5-video-player up to version 2.14.0. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 6.5.
